name: Fezola
description: Hosted, closed-source MCP server that connects several mailboxes and chats to one client: Gmail, iCloud and any IMAP mailbox (OVH, IONOS, Gandi, custom domains), plus Google Chat and Telegram read-only. Unified search across sources, a daily briefing of what needs a reply, and reply drafts saved in the right mailbox. Never sends mail on its own (send_message is disabled by default). Sign in with OAuth; free for 2 sources, Pro is 9 EUR/month. The linked GitHub repository holds documentation and client configs, not the server code.
author: Fezola
